offset_3d.describe: rolling constant offset over the last 3 available days

offset_7d.describe: rolling constant offset over the last 7 available days

offset_14d.describe: rolling constant offset over the last 14 available days

offset_28d.describe: rolling constant offset over the last 28 available days

diurnal_7d.describe: rolling hour-of-day offset table over 7 days

diurnal_14d.describe: rolling hour-of-day offset table over 14 days

diurnal_28d_shrunk.describe: rolling hour-of-day offset table over 28 days, shrunk 0.50 toward the grand mean

level_ar_fitted.describe: damped level update from the most recent fully observed day (phi fitted on history)

level_ar_phi05.describe: damped level update from the most recent fully observed day (phi=0.50 fixed)

lead_ar_7d.describe: lead-aware AR: the last observed residual hour scaled by the residual autocorrelation measured at each target's real lead, over 7 days

lead_ar_28d.describe: lead-aware AR: the last observed residual hour scaled by the residual autocorrelation measured at each target's real lead, over 28 days
